subject: Consolidated run-of-show & slot scrub for Renewal QBR (procurement checkpoint)

To: markus_klein@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Cc: procurement@clearwave.ai
Date: 2025-11-11T09:32:00-08:00
Subject: Renewal QBR — can we consolidate run-of-show + procurement checklist?

Markus / Marissa,

Thanks again for the Q3 run-through last week. The execs at ClearWave asked whether we can compress the Renewal QBR into one consolidated session next week rather than two scattered slots — they prefer a tighter 60-minute window split into two focused 25–30 minute demos (Roadmap + Integration). Procurement is being tight on calendar windows given an internal approval deadline on 11/20.

High-level asks from our side:
- Can Redwood host a paired demo (25 min product roadmap + 25 min technical integration walkthrough) back-to-back?
- We need a short procurement checklist (billing cadence, data residency note, POC terms) to confirm before legal kicks off redlines.

Availability from our execs: 11/17 between 09:00–12:00 PT or 11/18 after 13:00 PT. Procurement asked for any contract triggers or DocuSign steps that would help them prioritize.

Attaching our internal approval timeline (procurement attached). Happy to be flexible — let me know what would work on your side and we can lock in.

Thanks,
Emma
Emma Larson
Director, Customer Success | ClearWave.ai
(Attachment: clearwave_procurement_timeline.pdf)

From: markus_klein@redwood.ai
To: Emma Larson <emma.larson@clearwave.ai>, procurement@clearwave.ai
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, jonas_weber@redwood.ai
Date: 2025-11-11T11:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Renewal QBR — can we consolidate run-of-show + procurement checklist?

Emma — thanks for the heads up and the timeline. We can absolutely compress into a paired 60-minute block. Proposed approach below: 

Proposed run-of-show (60 min total):
- 0:00–5:00 (Intro + objectives) — Markus (Business value recap)
- 5:00–30:00 (Roadmap + prioritized features) — Marissa (Product + customer fit)
- 30:00–55:00 (Technical integration + migration plan) — Jonas (Solutions + ops)
- 55:00–60:00 (Next steps + procurement checkpoints) — Markus & Procurement

Proposed slots (PT):
- Option A: 2025-11-17 09:30–10:30
- Option B: 2025-11-17 10:30–11:30
- Option C: 2025-11-18 13:30–14:30

Procurement notes: I'll attach a 1-page checklist (billing cadence, SSO/KMS callouts, standard term flags) and flag any items that usually trigger a legal delay. Marissa — attaching the draft run_of_show_draft_v2.pdf for you to review; Jonas, please check the integration slot timing (we may need 30 extra seconds for the demo handoff).

If procurement can confirm the minimal contract trigger (e.g., PO vs signed agreement) we can prioritize the slot that meets your 11/20 internal deadline.

Markus Klein
Head of Sales Engineering | Redwood Inference
(Attachment: run_of_show_draft_v2.pdf)

From: marissa_cole@redwood.ai

Thanks — quick scrub from my side after reading Markus' draft. A couple of small ops notes and items to lock before we send a calendar invite: 

Run-of-show edits:
- Slide deck: cut to 18 slides total. I trimmed the feature examples to one vertical-specific example for time.
- Demo handoff: add a single one-slide state diagram (30s) to bridge roadmap -> integration.
- Recording & materials: confirm whether ClearWave wants the session recorded (default is yes; can opt-out).

Attendee ask:
- Please confirm who from ClearWave will attend the integration portion (network/infra contact) — we need a single point for the live demo to validate firewall/KMS notes.

Procurement checklist (quick preview — attached as Procurement-Checklist.xlsx):
- Billing cadence: Net 30 preferred; can discuss Net 45 for POC-only items.
- Data residency: US-only (standard) — confirm if EU/other regions needed.
- PO vs Agreement: procurement@clearwave.ai — which triggers are acceptable to start provisioning? If PO alone is enough, we'll queue Dedicated for provisioning pending signed agreement.

I can send the consolidated calendar invite once Emma confirms the integration contact and procurement confirms whether a PO suffices.

Marissa Cole
Sr. Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
(Attachment: Procurement-Checklist.xlsx)

From: ClearWave Procurement <procurement@clearwave.ai>
To: markus_klein@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Cc: Emma Larson <emma.larson@clearwave.ai>, jonas_weber@redwood.ai
Date: 2025-11-13T16:10:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Renewal QBR — can we consolidate run-of-show + procurement checklist?

Hi Markus / Marissa,

Thanks for the draft and the checklist. Quick answers from procurement: 
- A PO (formal purchase order) plus the standard Redwood SOW template is sufficient to trigger provisioning for the tech POC. Our internal legal team will still request redlines, but the PO gets us into the queue for capacity planning.
- Billing cadence: Net 30 is preferred. If Redwood needs a Net 45 for a short POC period, flag it clearly in the PO and we'll try to accommodate.
- Data residency: US-only is fine for now. If the customer later expands to EU we will restart the residency conversation.

We confirm availability for Option A (2025-11-17 09:30–10:30 PT). Please send a calendar invite with the final run-of-show and DocuSign link for the PO path.

Procurement Team
ClearWave.ai
